annotations.text:
This pass:

· The show's own key art is now the background, full bleed and unblurred — the app's real HeroBackdrop asset, not a stand-in. A flat 22% veil plus the left ramp is all that protects the text; no blur anywhere.

· Resume is gone. In its place, one unlabelled coral control that shuffles every episode of every season — the app already has exactly this (AppState.shufflePlayRequest returns .shuffled over all seasons), so it is a wiring change, not new behaviour.

· Continue-watching still lives in the drawer: E04 carries the NOW marker, its progress bar and 31:04 LEFT.

The + control does nothing today.

In ShowView.swift it is Button {} — an empty action, and the same dead stub sits on the movie screen. It is drawn as an affordance and answers no tap.

It reads as add-to-list / watchlist. Jellyfin has a favourite endpoint the player already calls (setFavorite / clearFavorite), so a heart here would be real and cheap. Say which you want and it goes in — otherwise it should come off the bar.

Episode stills in the drawer are still generated stand-ins — real ones come from Jellyfin per episode. Cast portraits use the app's own monogram fallback (CastPortrait), so these are exactly what shows when a headshot is missing.

Copy, ratings, seasons and episodes are the app's own reference show — SampleCatalog.show, The Deep Signal.

A — Deep Field (not chosen)

Cast as a poster billing block, seasons given the full width of a bottom band, the middle of the screen left to the art.

Kept for reference: the billing-block treatment of cast is still the cheapest way to kill truncated names if the drawer ever gets crowded.

Still carries the generated backdrop and its accent / scrim tweak chips.

C — Chapter Ruler (not chosen)

Every season and every episode drawn as ticks on one baseline, the current episode as a large frame, the rest as a two-column index, cast as a right-edge credit column.
